optimizedContext.value:
# Transition Checks

## Rules
- Registry bindings select predicates/effects by transition or archive operation; `Check.execute(ctx)` returns pass/fail/skip. Effects have binding phase and failure policy.
- Candidate evaluator runs `protocol.edge` first, matching transition predicates, then optional bypass step-skip predicates. `GetStatus` collects; `TransitionChange` fail-fast only on edge failure.
- `ReconcileChangeValidity` owns fresh facts, verdict, review, approvals, verification, recovery, audit, atomic persistence. All mutators delegate.
- Recovery priority: stale required spec approval -> `designing`; stale signoff later state -> `done`; stale verification renews in place; then artifact policy.
- Bindings cover workflow, deps/workspace, implementation, approvals, verification, archive, hooks. Approval commands record consent; no pending approval transitions.

## Constraints
- No snapshot bag or duplicate check gathering.
- Archive is operation, never fake transition.
- Schema never lists check IDs.
